test.create_query: CREATE TABLE distinct_final_vertical (k1 String, k2 String, payload String, v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(v) ORDER BY (k1, k2)
CREATE TABLE distinct_final_vertical_right (k1 String, payload String, v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(v) ORDER BY (k1, payload)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO distinct_final_vertical SELECT 'o' || toString(number % 50), toString(cityHash64(number)), toString(cityHash64(number, 7) % 1000000), 1 FROM numbers(4000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1

INSERT INTO distinct_final_vertical SELECT 'o' || toString(number % 50), toString(cityHash64(number)), toString(cityHash64(number, 7) % 1000000), 2 FROM numbers(2000000, 4000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO distinct_final_vertical_right SELECT 'o' || toString(number % 50), toString(number), 1 FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k1, k2 FROM distinct_final_vertical FINAL WHERE payload LIKE '1%')
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k1, k2 FROM distinct_final_vertical FINAL)

SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.k1, p.k2 FROM distinct_final_vertical AS p FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT k1, payload FROM distinct_final_vertical_right FINAL) AS c ON c.k1 = p.k1 AND c.payload = p.payload) SETTINGS query_plan_read_in_order_through_join = 1
